description:
“As expected of the Best Sword of Nangjung. I cannot let you live.” 

Ambushed and standing on the brink of death, Baek Yang Hwi despairs that he has yet to establish his family as a great clan. But just as all hope seems lost, he finds himself opening his eyes to an impossible reality. 

“Did I really return to when I was eight years old?” 

His family is third-rate, but his talent is unmatched throughout history. Starting his life anew, he vows that this time he will make his family the greatest clan in the entire world.
